content.title: Where To Watch Survivor
content.text: Find out how to watch Survivor 50 on CBS and Paramount+ By Joal Ryan | Published 8:00 AM EST Apr 2, 2026 CBS Survivor 50 airs on CBS, and streams on Paramount+. Read on for your guide to watching the historic 50th season of the CBS Original reality-competition series, featuring a cast of all-returning players, including Survivor legends Cirie Fields, Benjamin “Coach” Wade, Colby Donaldson, and Ozzy Lusth. Emmy® winner Jeff Probst hosts. Get Started With Paramount+ What time is Survivor on? New episodes of Survivor air at 8 PM ET/PT, Wednesdays on CBS. New episodes can be streamed live as they air on CBS on Paramount+ with a subscription to the Paramount+ Premium plan. How to watch and stream new episodes You can watch and stream new episodes of Survivor 50 on Paramount+. Paramount+ subscribers with the Paramount+ Premium plan can stream new episodes of Survivor‘s latest new season, also known as Survivor 50, as they air live on CBS. All Paramount+ subscribers can stream new episodes of Survivor on demand on the day after the episode airs live on CBS via any Paramount+ plan. When do new episodes premiere? New episodes of Survivor 50 launch weekly on Wednesdays through the season finale. All the tune-in info you need to watch the season is below. Show: Survivor 50 New episodes launch: Wednesdays at 8 PM ET/PT Channel: CBS Streaming: Paramount+* New episodes of Survivor 50 can be streamed live on Paramount+ as they air on CBS via the Paramount+ Premium plan, or they can be streamed on the day after they air via any Paramount+ plan. What channel is Survivor on? Survivor airs on CBS. You can watch the show’s traditional broadcast on your TV or screen using cable, satellite, a live-TV streaming service, or a digital antenna. Where to watch every season of Survivor CBS You can watch every season of Survivor with Paramount+. Navigate to the Survivor show page via the Paramount+ app, or on ParamountPlus.com, to find more than 700 episodes on demand – a haul that runs from Survivor Season 1 to all the newest seasons, and includes everything in between, including fan-favorite installments such as Survivor Season 20 (aka Survivor: Heroes vs. Villains), Survivor Season 28 (aka Survivor: Cagayan – Brawn vs. Brains vs. Beauty), and Survivor Season 33 (aka Survivor: Millennials vs. Gen X). Every alliance, blindside, hero, villain, genius tactic, massive blunder, and epic tribal council – they’re all here. All Paramount+ subscribers can explore The Survivor Collection, and enjoy curated episode playlists, such as “Iconic Episodes,” “Biggest Blindsides,” “The Best of Cirie,” and more. How many Survivor seasons are there (including Survivor 50)? Including Survivor 50, there are 50 seasons of Survivor. Here is the list of every Survivor season.
